reason: It's $36 for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of, with no reviews, and all I've seen of it is a Facebook ad. I already have a drawer of lipsticks I wore once, and if I want a sheer pink I can try one at the Sephora counter and know what it looks like before I pay.
objection: I can't tell who these people are or whether that 365-day guarantee is real. I've been caught before by an ad that looked honest, and trying to get money back from a small website is exactly the hassle I avoid by buying at the counter.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it sold at Ulta or Sephora, or a lot of real reviews from women my age with photos showing it doesn't dry out or bleed into the lines.
